svg.title: Candidate eight-address Hagalaz local-generator layout
svg.desc: Eight positions surround a central Hagalaz rune. Top positions are xw, yw, zw bending channels. Bottom positions are xy, xz, yz normal-space twist channels. Left middle is log mu for scale and right middle is xi for normalized rung advance.

g.text: Class P candidate — eight-address Hagalaz local generator
pole / tangent bending channels (planes containing w)
equatorial / normal-space twist channels (planes not containing w)
8-slot rung-locked specialization = 6 SO(4) rotation channels + 1 scale + 1 normalized rung displacement
Candidate formalization; not yet canonical. Source: Meridian RUN 091, 2026-09-21
